entries.title: Australia
entries.subtitle: Market passport · partial
entries.search_text: Australia AU market_passport AUSTRAC VASP registration and ASIC financial-product/AFS boundaries are separate. Neither should be rendered as a generic Australian crypto licence. not_applicable AML + financial-product map AUSTRAC VASP registration is not an ASIC AFS licence. ASIC INFO 225 states that digital-asset classification depends on the facts and is not exhaustive. No entity-level AUSTRAC or ASIC result is held.

entries.title: Brazil
entries.subtitle: Market passport · source_unavailable
entries.search_text: Brazil BR market_passport A BCB virtual-asset framework source surface, presented without unsupported provider entity claims. not_applicable The held BCB framework sources are not a current provider entity registry; this market surface publishes no provider entity claims. Other Brazilian source families, including any public authorisation register and enforcement sources, are outside this held surface until fetched and parsed.

entries.title: Canada
entries.subtitle: Market passport · partial
entries.search_text: Canada CA market_passport A FINTRAC registry-source surface for virtual-currency service rows, presented separately from provincial and other Canadian source families. not_applicable A FINTRAC registry record is a statement about the displayed registration fields and is not an endorsement, licence, permission, or compliance finding. Provincial securities, derivatives, payment, enforcement, and other Canadian source families are not held by this market surface.

entries.title: Hong Kong
entries.subtitle: Market passport · partial
entries.search_text: Hong Kong HK market_passport SFC virtual-asset trading-platform status lists. Licensed, applicant and removed list entries are distinct records. not_applicable VATP status surface An applicant or deemed-to-be-licensed applicant is not formally licensed. SFC VATP lists do not represent every Hong Kong virtual-asset regulatory surface.

entries.title: Japan
entries.subtitle: Market passport · partial
entries.search_text: Japan JP market_passport FSA exchange-provider registration plus a separate JVCEA self-regulatory source surface. Registration and SRO materials must not be merged. not_applicable Statutory + SRO map No JVCEA individual membership list or token-list artifact is held. FSA registration and JVCEA self-regulatory information are distinct evidence surfaces.

entries.title: Singapore
entries.subtitle: Market passport · partial
entries.search_text: Singapore SG market_passport A MAS-led digital-payment-token surface. Open the coverage passport for exact source families and known boundaries. not_applicable A directory record is a statement about the filtered MAS Financial Institutions Directory, not a whole-of-business permission or compliance finding. Digital Token Service Provider treatment under the Financial Services and Markets Act is a separate source family and is not yet held. Enforcement, exemptions, and Standard Payment Institution DPT listings remain separately unresolved.

evidence.locator: MAS Financial Institutions Directory — DPT Major Payment Institutions

entries.title: South Korea
entries.subtitle: Market passport · partial

Other Korean source families, including any separately published registry, are outside this held surface until fetched and parsed.
